auxiliary_metric: worst minimum enclosing circle radius; not a replacement primary metric

physical_source_K.definition: D0 ∩ W1 ∩ {5 < r1 <= 1500}; use configured radii

guaranteed_reception_C_safe.definition: intersection over G in K of B(G,max(r_min,r1(G)))
guaranteed_reception_C_safe.representation: implicit exact mathematical definition; full boundary not computed

analytic_safe_C_cert.relation: sufficient subset of C_safe; inward numeric guard used for search

effective_direction_C0.definition: C_cert with dist(p,T)>near and angular separation >3alpha+margin
effective_direction_C0.guarantees: normal second reading and bounded angular intersection

preferred_detection_region.representation: finite evaluated candidates; no continuous near-optimal-region certificate
preferred_detection_region.metric: worst diameter over conservative one-dimensional H reading interval
